accepted_behavior.device_boundary: NetworkDevice moves raw frames through caller-owned buffers and does not own protocol parsing.
accepted_behavior.parser_boundary: ReceivedFrame, EthernetFrame, ArpPacket, and Ipv4Packet parse immutable byte slices without allocation or hardware access.
ipv4: truncated, wrong-version, invalid-IHL, invalid-total-length, and truncated-total-length rejection

findings.finding: device movement and protocol parsing ownership separated
Ethernet, ARP, and IPv4 positive and negative parser tests added
checksum, fragmentation, higher protocols, queues, dispatch, and stack dependency selection remain outside this task
hardware readiness, live packet I/O, sockets, SSH, and hardware-driver readiness remain unaccepted
no dead code or prior evidence removal was required
no hardware lock or Pi 5 inconclusive-run triage was required

accepted_claims: Phase 12.2 has a local no_std network device/protocol boundary.
Ethernet II, Ethernet/IPv4 ARP, and IPv4 parsing are unit-tested over byte slices.
Malformed and truncated parser inputs return deterministic errors.
